text:
Alex (CS): Quick capture from a call w/ NovaHealth — they're worried about embedding costs ballooning across many small routes. Ask: per-route feature toggle to disable embeddings + an API flag to opt back in, and a console default off for shared/team accounts. They said renewal is in ~3 months; cost visibility here is a gating factor.
Maya (PM): Thanks Alex — can you paste the exact phrasing they used? We need to quote for product and legal.
Alex (CS): they said: 'We need to stop embeddings from running on low-traffic routes by default. Give us an on/off switch at the route level and an API param so our infra can programmatically enable it per customer. Also, surface the savings estimates in the console.'
Devon (SE): That maps to two things: (1) per-route boolean in the API/console, (2) per-route token/accounting so billing & estimates work. We have per-route config but not a soft-toggle that prevents embedding calls from being routed to embedding model. Est. effort: small backend + console toggle + billing hook — I'd ballpark 3-5 dev days + 2 days QA.
Priya (Prod Ops): UX-wise we'll need: toggle in route settings, roll-out toggles for org vs team vs route. Also audit log entry when toggle changes. We should add a warning tooltip about potential quality/regression.
Ben (CS): Marking renewal risk. Recommend "pilot" label and offer NovaHealth a trial config. Can Alex confirm they'd be willing to pilot the toggle if we ship alpha?
Alex (CS): Yes — they said they'd pilot and give feedback. I'll collect a short list of 3 routes they want toggled and share.
Kelsey (Data): Please tag this with labels: cost-control, per-route-toggle, renewal-risk in the CS tracker. We should also add a telemetry signal: embed call count pre/post toggle so we can show savings.
ticket-bot: Created ticket CS-2045: "per-route embedding toggle + API flag" — link: https://redwood.atlas/CS-2045
Maya (PM): Acceptance criteria draft: 1) Console route toggle (default off for shared/team accounts), 2) API param (route.create/update with "embedding_enabled": boolean), 3) Billing/telemetry emits per-route token delta, 4) Audit log for toggle changes, 5) Migration plan to opt existing routes in/out.
Devon (SE): I'll scope a spike for the billing hook and share a doc by EOD Tuesday.
Priya (Prod Ops): I'll mock a quick UX and put screenshots in the ticket.
Ben (CS): If devs agree to the timeline, I'll email NovaHealth with pilot next steps and confirm their pilot routes. :thumbsup:
Alex (CS): Sending the verbatim ask and pilot list in a follow-up thread. Thanks all.
